prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: I was just reminiscing about that Shanghai trip in 2025—funny how we basically did a whole little car-rental comparison thing for getting around.
And we did the same kind of browsing for spots to see in Shanghai too—like a mini attractions shortlist before we even landed.
My friend ended up grabbing a Toyota Corolla for it, picked up on 2025-04-18, and it was just for 1 day—super quick turnaround.
Oh, and the rental was under Noah Wilson’s name—meanwhile I remember checking my card balance later from that account 6222021234567890 just to make sure everything had cleared.
For sightseeing, we did The Bund on 2025-03-20 in the morning—Song Qi was the visitor name on it, and it was 2 tickets. All ancient history now, but it was a great day.
